# Vendored scripts

Copied unchanged from the npm registry (`npm pack`), so the app works offline. Licences are in `licenses/`.

| File | Package | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `xterm.js`, `xterm.css` | `@xterm/xterm` 5.5.0 | MIT |
| `addon-fit.js` | `@xterm/addon-fit` 0.10.0 | MIT |
| `highlight.min.js` | `@highlightjs/cdn-assets` 11.10.0 (common languages) | BSD-3-Clause |
| `hljs-powershell.min.js` | `@highlightjs/cdn-assets` 11.10.0, `languages/powershell.min.js` | BSD-3-Clause |
| `marked.min.js` | `marked` 12.0.2 | MIT |
| `purify.min.js` | `dompurify` 3.1.6 | Apache-2.0 or MPL-2.0 |
